verdict.rationale: Square documents its own Invoices API, and its MCP service catalog lists invoices, so it ships first-party invoicing. However, the pack contains only the API's title, with no description of hosted invoice pages, online payment of invoices, or reminder scheduling. missing for 10: evidence of hosted/shareable invoice pages, evidence that invoices can be paid online, evidence of automatic payment reminders, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders
